Maya (CSM): hey team — kicking off Crux Systems onboarding. main goals for week 0: confirm API keys, validate sample traffic, and run first acceptance eval by EOW. quick roll call of stakeholders pls.
Diego (AE): i'll add Diego + Crux product folks to calendar. @Ravi can you own the SE onboarding and first-run guidance?
Ravi (Solutions Eng): yep, i'll own SE onboarding. plan: 1) env checklist 2) small integration demo 3) prompt quality baseline. need VPC/SSO details from Crux.
Olivia (Enablement): i can do a 45m enablement session (how we monitor cost+latency in Console) — Wed 10am PT works?
Maya (CSM): Wed 10am PT works. Olivia please include a quick demo of the Optimize suggestions. Crux cares about cost.
Diego (AE): flagged renewal horizon in 11 months — want to capture early success criteria: 1) <100ms p95 for simple prompts 2) cost per 1k tokens below target 3) 2 pilot features live. agree? :thinking_face:
Ravi (Solutions Eng): agree. i'll instrument latency traces and attach initial dashboard. also will run 1 sample eval set to measure quality vs baseline.
Maya (CSM): noted renewal risk — if latency/cost not met they will push back. we'll do weekly health checks for first 8 weeks.
OnboardBot: new kickoff created for #Crux — checklist link: https://redwood.internal/onboard/checklists/4213141592 (automated reminders set: weekly health reports) :robot_face:
Olivia (Enablement): capture feedback plan: short survey after enablement + a 5-example prompt set we send weekly for quality regression checks. i’ll own the survey and calendar invite.
Diego (AE): Crux contact is bhavana@cruxsys.com. want to set a 30-min alignment with their infra lead before demo. Maya can you schedule?
Maya (CSM): done — invite sent for Mon 9am PT. agenda: SSO/VPC items, keys, and minimal test traffic.
Ravi (Solutions Eng): quick checklist snippet i'm sharing for Monday prep:
```
- confirm service account key exchange
- validate subnet routes for VPC peering
- whitelist Redwood egress IPs
- run smoke test: simple completion -> 10k tokens total
- capture p95 latency and token cost
```
Diego (AE): perfect. small ask — can we include a success metric doc that ties to renewal? i'll draft and post in the thread by EOD.
Maya (CSM): thanks. final: weekly sync cadence will be Tue 30m standup (status, risks, blockers). Olivia will run enablement Wed. Ravi leads tech. Diego owns stakeholder comms. i'll own overall success criteria + renewal tracking.
Olivia (Enablement): noted. will post the enablement deck and the post-session survey link here after Wed. :white_check_mark:
Maya (CSM): great team. if any blockers before Mon, ping @Maya. otherwise see you Monday 9am PT. :rocket:
